description: Unique polygon identifier. Each record is one spatially connected Polygon; no multipart records.
Source colour class; joins colour_classes.csv. NOT a unique geological unit when colours are duplicated.
Unique pre-smoothing connected component identifier. One exported feature per retained component.
Code transcribed from legend; alternatives separated by |. Codes in the source are not globally unique.
Stable L001-L092 legend row identifiers. Alternatives separated by |; blank for water/unresolved.
Full legible lithological description, or all same-colour alternatives. Unresolved classes explicitly identified.
Formation/group or depositional description as printed. Alternatives separated by |. Not stated where absent.
Legend group/suite where available; otherwise descriptive Sedimentary/Volcanic/Surficial deposits.
Broad age bracket as printed, not corrected to modern stratigraphy. No inferred numerical ages.
colour_match = unique palette match, NOT field-verified; ambiguous = duplicated swatch; unresolved = no close swatch; visual_water = filled water colour.
1 for all features: manual verification recommended for this raster-derived dataset.
1 if feature touches the cropped map frame; such edges must not be interpreted as natural boundaries.
Absolute ellipsoidal area on assumed WGS84, square kilometres; not survey accuracy.
Ellipsoidal exterior-ring perimeter, kilometres (hole perimeters excluded).
Area of cleaned source component in full-resolution raster pixels, before smoothing.
